title: Guide on How to Setup and Use the HighLevel MCP Server
snippet:
Connect your AI assistant to HighLevel so it can find CRM records and perform supported actions from your instructions. The HighLevel MCP Server, also called the LeadConnector MCP Server, connects through OAuth: sign in, choose the sub-account or sub-accounts to include, and approve the requested permissions.

MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It gives AI assistants a standard way to discover and use tools from connected applications. With the HighLevel MCP Server, your assistant can work with supported CRM data and actions without you needing to know the underlying API.
The active catalog includes **more than 600 read, create, update, and delete operations across 38 domains**. The operations available to your connection depend on the OAuth scopes and permissions you approve.
---
## **Before You Connect**
You need access to the HighLevel sub-account or sub-accounts you want to connect and a supported AI client. ChatGPT users can find the official HighLevel plugin in Plugins. Muse and Grok Bot also offer officially listed apps. For custom MCP connections, use the corresponding URL below.
| AI client | Connection method |
|---|---|
| **Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork** | `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2` |
| **ChatGPT, Codex, and other compatible OpenAI clients** | `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/` |
| **Cursor** | `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/cursor/v2` |
| **Muse** | Connect the official app in Muse; its OAuth endpoint is `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/muse/v2/` |
| **Grok Bot** | Add HighLevel from **Connect apps** |
| **ChatGPT** | Open ChatGPT → Plugins, search for HighLevel, and connect through OAuth. No manual MCP server URL is required. |
These connections use OAuth. During authorization, sign in to LeadConnector, select the available sub-account(s), and approve the requested scopes. All connection options use the current active LeadConnector MCP operation catalog.

## **How the Four MCP Tools Work**
The server exposes four unified tools. Your assistant uses these tools to find and run the operations available to your connection.
| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `list_locations` | Find the sub-accounts available to the connection, or return its single bound sub-account. |
| `search_operations` | Discover active operations for the task, including record searches and read, create, update, and delete actions. |
| `describe_operation` | Check an operation's inputs, example pay

title: HighLevel MCP Server Setup and Configuration Guide
snippet:
## **What is HighLevel MCP Server?**
The HighLevel MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server provides a secure way for AI agents and MCP-compatible applications to interact with HighLevel tools and services. Using the MCP Server, AI assistants can retrieve records, update data, automate workflows, and execute actions directly inside HighLevel.
The MCP Server supports integrations across multiple HighLevel services, including contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments, and locations.
**Production MCP Endpoint**
```plaintext
https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/
```
---
## **Key Benefits of HighLevel MCP Server**
The MCP Server helps developers and AI builders create secure, scalable, and AI-powered workflows inside HighLevel.
- **Centralized AI Access:** Connect AI agents to multiple HighLevel services through a single MCP endpoint.
- **Secure Authentication:** Use Private Integration Tokens with scoped permissions for secure access.
- **Natural Language Automation:** Allow AI assistants to execute workflows using conversational prompts.
- **Multi-Service Connectivity:** Access contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars, payments, and more.
- **MCP-Compatible Flexibility:** Connect with Cursor, Windsurf, OpenAI Playground, Claude-compatible clients, and custom MCP applications.
---
## **Supported MCP Clients**
The HighLevel MCP Server supports MCP-compatible applications that can connect through HTTP.
Supported clients include:
- Cursor
- Windsurf
- OpenAI Playground
- Claude-compatible MCP clients
- Custom MCP-compatible applications
---
## **Prerequisites**
Proper setup ensures secure and reliable MCP access for your AI workflows.
Before configuring the MCP Server, make sure you have:
- Access to a HighLevel location
- A Private Integration Token
- Required integration scopes enabled
- An MCP-compatible client
---
## **Generate a Private Integration Token**
Private Integration Tokens allow MCP-compatible clients to securely authenticate with HighLevel services.
### **How To Create a Token**
1. Log in to HighLevel.
2. Open the desired sub-account/location.
3. Navigate to **Settings**
.
4. Click **Private Integrations**.
5. Select **Create New Integration**.
6. Choose the required scopes.
7. Click **Create Integration**.
8. Copy and securely store the generated token.
---

title: Connect AI Clients to Project Management MCP | HighLevel
snippet:
HighLevel Project Management now connects with compatible AI assistants through Model Context Protocol (MCP), making it easier to organize and manage project work using natural language. With this integration, you can create and update tasks, subtasks, Spaces, and Lists without switching between your AI client and HighLevel. You can also work with custom statuses, custom field values, and task comments through an authorized connection. This guide covers how to connect a supported AI client using OAuth and start managing Project Management work through MCP.

Project Management MCP is an integration that connects compatible AI clients to HighLevel Project Management through Model Context Protocol (MCP). MCP allows an AI assistant to discover and use supported HighLevel operations through a standardized connection.
Instead of opening Project Management whenever you need to create tasks, organize Lists, or review comments, you can describe the action in your connected AI client.
The integration supports creating and managing tasks, subtasks, Spaces, and Lists. It also supports working with custom statuses, custom field values, and task comments.
Connections use a hosted MCP endpoint and OAuth authentication. You authorize the connection through your own account rather than configuring shared credentials or building directly against the Projects REST API.

- **Simplified integration:** Use hosted MCP connectivity to work with supported project operations without building directly against the Projects REST API.

Choose the MCP endpoint associated with your AI client. The following endpoints are documented in HighLevel's MCP resources.
| AI Client | Hosted MCP Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Claude.ai | `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2` |
| Claude Code | `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2` |
